expected_structural_delta: Add one route-parser/provider module, one parser test file, one existing-client wiring change, and one repository-local pnpm patch with lock/config entries; add no new runtime service or API route.
minimum_design: Use the existing UPnP client with a local default-gateway allow-list, validate route output, and apply a repository-local pnpm patch to nat-upnp for SSDP response and control-URL validation.
outcome: When Unraid API performs UPnP gateway discovery on a supported host, a LAN device that is not the host's default gateway cannot cause the API to fetch or invoke an attacker-controlled UPnP endpoint.

reuse_decisions.name: Existing UPnP client
reuse_decisions.rationale: helpers.ts already owns the singleton and can supply gateway addresses without a second client.

reuse_decisions.name: Existing execa dependency
reuse_decisions.rationale: The API already depends on execa for subprocess boundaries, so route lookup needs no new dependency.

reuse_decisions.name: @runonflux/nat-upnp package
reuse_decisions.rationale: The package owns SSDP and SOAP behavior; a repository-local pnpm patch keeps the security fix in this API while upstream publication remains out of scope.

reuse_decisions.name: MockUpnpClient
reuse_decisions.rationale: The Docker path already uses the mock client and does not perform live SSDP discovery.
